text:
alyssa: Need a tiny demo widget to preview automatic fallback policies for an upcoming customer call. minimal, live, no PII.
tariq: Sounds good. Core requirements?
alyssa: 1) run a policy against sample traffic 2) show which rule fired and why 3) export an anonymized audit with retention tag.
ben: We can hit the policy-engine dryrun. It returns decision + reasons. But it currently includes raw request fields.
tariq: We should add a redaction step + a compact decision_reason (code + summary). Also add selected_variant in response.
ben: Agreed. I'll add a `redacted` boolean and `operator_id` and `sample_rate` metadata to the dryrun audit event.
eng-bot: infra: dryrun endpoint available on staging at https://staging.api.redwood/policy/dryrun since 2025-03-01.
alyssa: UX: presets like "503 spike" and "latency tail" and a stepper showing rule matches. click a card to expand JSON. Keep the main line human-readable e.g., "LATENCY_HIGH -> soft fallback".
tariq: Also add a preview vs apply toggle. Preview runs dryrun, apply posts to staging policy apply endpoint.
ben: For export, we'll produce a zipped payload: CSV summary + JSON full traces. Everything must be anonymized and include `retention_label`.
alyssa: Timeline: ben do backend tweaks by EOD, tariq mock a Figma prototype tomorrow AM, alyssa will draft the demo script.
tariq: I'll include keyboard shortcuts for the stepper and a compact graph for error/latency.
ben: sample policy for demo: { name: "demo-soft-handback", triggers: [{type: "status_rate", code: 503, threshold: 0.05}], action: "soft_fallback", sample_rate: 0.1 }
alyssa: Great. follow-ups: ben (redaction + metadata + export), tariq (prototype + presets), alyssa (script).
